[[File:Thrust_cone.png|thumb|DUM-4 holding out a thrust cone to Gasgano.]]
'''Thrust stabilizer cones''' (or simply '''thrust cones''') were cone-shaped components that sat at the back of a [[Podracer/Legends|podracer's]] engines.<ref name="TPMVD">''[[Star Wars: Episode I: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

The [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Gasgano/Legends|Gasgano]] once accepted to provide [[DUM-4/Legends|DUM-4]] with a power plug in exchange for a thrust cone from [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba's]] podracer pit in [[Mos Espa Grand Arena/Legends|Mos Espa Grand Arena]].<ref name="APD">''[[Anakin's Pit Droid]]''</ref>
